entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. My name is Jenny, and I'm here to assist you today. How can I help?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little while ago, and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I can certainly assist you with a return. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's...hold on... it's jane.doe@email.com. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.

Thank you, Ms. Doe. I've located your order. I see here you purchased a VeloBand Pulse on October 26th. Today is November 10th. Can you tell me what issues you are experiencing with the VeloBand Pulse?

It's just not accurate! The heart rate readings are all over the place. I bought it to track my workouts accurately, and it's completely useless. Honestly, I should have just bought a different smart watch.

I apologize that you're experiencing difficulties with your VeloBand Pulse. We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. I understand the frustration when a device doesn't perform as expected.
So, can I return it or what? What's the hold up? This is ridiculous.

Absolutely. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after purchase. Since you're well within that window, I can process the return for you right now. I see you want to return the VeloBand Pulse. Is that correct?
Yes, that's right! Finally. So, what do I need to do?

Okay, Ms. Doe. I've initiated the return process. You'll receive an email within the next few minutes with a prepaid shipping label. Simply print the label, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, a full refund will be credited back to your original form of payment.
And how long will the refund take?
You should see the refund reflected in your account within 7-10 business days after we receive the returned item. It depends on your bank's processing times.
Okay, I guess that's fine. Thank you. This whole thing has been a pain.
You're welcome, Ms. Doe. I apologize again for the inconvenience. Just to confirm, you received an email with the return label and instructions. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks for finally getting it done. I appreciate it.

You're very welcome. Have a great day, Ms. Doe. And thank you for choosing VeloFit. If you have any further questions, feel free to call us back. The return policy information is also available on our website. Goodbye.
